blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Chromosome and DNA) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Who discovered chromosomes and who gave them their name?
(Chromosomes kis ne daryaft kiye aur un ka naam kis ne rakha?)
blocks.explanation: Chromosomes German embryologist Walther Flemming ne 1882 mein salamander larvae ke tezi se taqseem hone wale cells mein daryaft kiye. Naam "chromosome" (rangeen ajsaam) German anatomist Waldeyer-Hartz ne 1888 mein diya.

book_ref.quote: He discovered chromosomes in the rapidly dividing cells of salamander larvae

blocks.prompt:
2 What is a karyotype? How do somatic cells and gametes differ in chromosomes?
(Karyotype kya hai? Somatic cells aur gametes chromosomes mein kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation: Karyotype kisi species ke chromosomes ka poora set hai, apni tadaad aur shakal ke saath. Diploid organisms ke somatic cells mein chromosomes homologous joron mein hote hain; gametes mein aadhe hote hain aur jore nahin hote.

book_ref.quote: The number and shape of chromosomes are different in each species

blocks.prompt:
3 How does chromatin change into chromosomes when a cell prepares to divide?
(Cell ke taqseem ki tayyari mein chromatin chromosomes mein kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA lipatna shuru karti hai aur histones ki chhoti ikaiyon ke gird lipat-ti hai. Yeh ikaiyan mazeed lipat kar bohat ghani ho jati hain; zyada lipatne se structure mota aur chhota hota hai aur aakhir mein ghane dhaage jaise chromosomes ban jate hain.

book_ref.quote: When a cell prepares to divide, the DNA starts to coil

blocks.prompt:
4 What are sister chromatids? Where are they joined?
(Sister chromatids kya hain? Woh kahan jurte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interphase mein chromatin ki duplication ke baad har chromosome do aik jaisi strands par mushtamil hota hai jinhein sister chromatids kehte hain. Yeh aik tang hisse, centromere, par aapas mein jurti hain.

book_ref.quote: They are attached to each other at a constricted region called the centromere

blocks.prompt:
5 What is a kinetochore? Write its function.
(Kinetochore kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kinetochore centromere se lagi disc jaisi protein structure hai. Cell division mein chromosomes isi jagah mitotic spindle se jurte hain.

book_ref.quote: It serves as the point where chromosomes attach to the mitotic spindle

blocks.prompt:
6 What is secondary constriction? What is its function?
(Secondary constriction kya hai? Is ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch chromosomes mein centromere ke ilawa aik aur tang hissa hota hai jise secondary constriction ya Nuclear Organizer Region (NOR) kehte hain. Yeh interphase mein nucleoli banata hai.

book_ref.quote: In some chromosomes, there may be another constriction

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a satellite of a chromosome? What is junk DNA?
(Chromosome ka satellite kya hai? Junk DNA kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary constriction ke saath chromosome ka ghundi jaisa sira satellite kehlata hai. Is hisse mein bohat dohrai wali DNA sequences hoti hain jinhein junk DNA kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This region has highly repetitive DNA sequences called junk DNA

blocks.prompt:
8 What are telomeres? Why are they important?
(Telomeres kya hain? Yeh kyun ahem hain?)
blocks.explanation: Telomeres chromosomes ke aakhri sire hain. Yeh do chromosomes ko apne siron se aapas mein jurne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: They prevent the two chromosomes to attach with each other from their ends

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between metacentric and acrocentric chromosomes.
(Metacentric aur acrocentric chromosomes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq centromere ki jagah ka hai.

book_ref.quote: The chromosomes in which centromere is at the centre are called metacentric chromosomes

rows: Centromere bilkul markaz mein
Centromere sire ke qareeb

blocks.text: 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome

blocks.prompt:
10 Why does DNA bind strongly to histone proteins?
(DNA histone proteins se mazbooti se kyun jurti hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA phosphate groups ki wajah se negative hai, jab ke histones arginine aur lysine jaise basic amino acids ki kasrat ki wajah se positive hain. Is liye DNA histones se mazboot kashish rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: It has strong affinity to histone proteins

blocks.prompt:
11 What is a nucleosome? Name the histones of its octamer.
(Nucleosome kya hai? Is ke octamer ke histones ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleosome woh majmua hai jo DNA ke taqreeban 146 nucleotides ke histone octamer ke gird do dafa lipatne se banta hai. Octamer 8 histones ka set hai: H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies.

book_ref.quote: set of 8 histone molecules i.e., two copies each of the histones

blocks.prompt:
12 What are linker DNA and linker histone?
(Linker DNA aur linker histone kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Linker DNA taqreeban 80 nucleotides ka hissa hai jo nucleosomes ko jorta hai. Linker histone H1 (paanchwein qisam ka histone) nucleosome ki base par DNA ke dakhil aur kharij hone ki jagah hota hai aur nucleosomes ki chain ke lipatne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps in the winding of the chain of nucleosomes

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between nucleosome string and chromatin fibre.
(Nucleosome string aur chromatin fibre mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono chromosome ki tanzeem ke darje hain; chromatin fibre nucleosome string ke mazeed lipatne se banti hai.

book_ref.quote: the nucleosome string again coils about its axis

rows: Nucleosomes (linker histone ke baghair) dhaage par motiyon ki tarah
Mazbooti se bandhe (ghane) nucleosomes
11 nm moti
30 nm moti
Replication ke baad DNA ke histone octamers par lipatne se banti hai
Cell division ke shuru mein nucleosome string ke apne mehwar par dobara lipatne se banti hai

blocks.prompt:
14 What is a supercoil? How is a chromatid formed from it?
(Supercoil kya hai? Is se chromatid kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromatin fibre khud par tah ho kar supercoil banati hai jo 300 nm moti hai. Supercoil mazeed lipat kar ghana hota hai aur chromatid ki shakal ikhtiyar karta hai jo 700 nm mota hai.

book_ref.quote: The supercoil further coils and condenses

blocks.text: 19.1.3 The Concept of Genes and Alleles

blocks.prompt:
15 Give an example to show that alleles lie at the same locus on homologous chromosomes.
(Misaal se wazeh karein ke alleles homologous chromosomes par aik hi locus par hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Agar aik chromosome par aankh ke rang ka allele kisi khaas locus par ho, to us ka homologous chromosome bhi isi khoobi (aankh ka rang) ka allele usi locus par rakhega.

book_ref.quote: if a chromosome has the allele for

blocks.prompt:
16 Which facts had been confirmed before scientists asked whether genes are made of DNA or protein?
(Kaun se haqaiq pehle tasdeeq ho chuke the jin ke baad scientists ne poocha ke genes DNA ke bane hain ya protein ke?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Genes wirasat ki ikaiyan hain.
2. Genes chromosomes par hote hain.
3. Chromosomes DNA aur proteins se bane hain.

book_ref.quote: Genes are located on chromosomes, and

blocks.prompt:
17 List the characteristics a molecule must have to serve as genetic material.
(Genetic material banne ke liye molecule mein kaun si khasiyat honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Proteins mein amino acids ki tarteeb ka code de.
2. Cell division se pehle apni copy banaye.
3. Eukaryotic cells ke nucleus mein ho.
4. Waqt ke saath badal sake taa ke evolution ho.
Sirf DNA yeh sab poora karti hai.

book_ref.quote: A molecule that serves as genetic material must have certain characteristics

blocks.prompt:
18 Differentiate between the S-type and R-type strains of Streptococcus pneumoniae.
(Streptococcus pneumoniae ke S-type aur R-type strains mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono strains coat, colony aur chuhon par asar mein mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: strain lacked polysaccharide coat and forms a

rows: Polysaccharide coat hota hai
Polysaccharide coat nahin hota
Smooth (hamwar) colony banata hai
Rough (khurdari) colony banata hai
Virulent: chuhon ko pneumonia hua aur woh mar gaye
Non-virulent: chuhon par koi asar nahin hua

blocks.prompt:
19 What did Griffith think was the cause of the virulence of S-type bacteria?
(Griffith ke khayal mein S-type bacteria ke virulent hone ki wajah kya thi?)
blocks.explanation: Griffith ne socha ke S-type ka virulent asar shayad us ke polysaccharide coat ki wajah se hai jo use host ke immune system se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: Griffith thought that the virulent effect of S-type might be due to its polysaccharide coat

blocks.prompt:
20 What is transformation? What did Griffith conclude from it?
(Transformation kya hai? Griffith ne is se kya natija nikala?)
blocks.explanation: Transformation aik organism se doosre mein genetic material ki muntaqili hai jis se lene wale ki genetic banawat badal jati hai. Griffith ne natija nikala ke coat aur virulence ki maloomat maare gaye S-type se zinda R-type mein gayi aur woh virulent S-type ban gaya.

book_ref.quote: the transfer of genetic material from one organism to another

blocks.prompt:
21 How did Avery, MacLeod and McCarty show that proteins are not the transforming principle?
(Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty ne kaise dikhaya ke proteins transforming principle nahin?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne maare gaye S-type se proteins nikal kar zinda R-type ke saath milaye. Is mixture se chuhe bimar hue aur un mein zinda S-type mile. Yani proteins ke baghair bhi transformation hui.

book_ref.quote: It means that proteins are not responsible for transforming R-type into S-type

blocks.prompt:
22 What are bacteriophages? What happens when a lytic bacteriophage infects a bacterium?
(Bacteriophages kya hain? Jab lytic bacteriophage bacterium par hamla kare to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteriophages woh viruses hain jo bacteria par hamla karte hain; un mein core (DNA ya RNA) aur protein coat hota hai. Lytic phage bacteria ki satah se jur kar material inject karta hai jo naye phages banwata hai; aakhir mein cell phat jata hai aur naye phages nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Bacteriophages consist of a core (made of DNA or RNA) and a protein coat

blocks.prompt:
23 How did Hershey and Chase label the protein and the DNA of bacteriophages separately?
(Hershey aur Chase ne bacteriophages ki protein aur DNA ko alag alag kaise nishaan zada kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch phages ³⁵S wale medium par ugaye gaye; yeh protein coat ke amino acids mein shamil hua. Doosre ³²P ke saath ugaye gaye; yeh DNA ke phosphate groups mein shamil hua.

book_ref.quote: Some bacteriophages were grown on a medium containing an isotope of sulphur

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between the results of setup 1 and setup 2 of the Hershey-Chase experiment.
(Hershey-Chase tajarbe ke setup 1 aur setup 2 ke nataij mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono setups mein mukhtalif nishaan wale bacteriophages the.

book_ref.quote: radioactivity was observed in bacterial cells and not in the medium

rows: ³⁵S wali protein ke bacteriophages
³²P wali DNA ke bacteriophages
Radioactivity medium mein mili, cells mein nahin
Radioactivity cells mein mili, medium mein nahin
Protein coat bahar raha
DNA cells mein gayi aur naye phages banwaye

blocks.prompt:
25 Define DNA replication. When does it take place?
(DNA replication ki definition likhein. Yeh kab hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA replication woh amal hai jis mein DNA molecule apni bilkul aik jaisi copy banata hai; DNA do strands wali hai is liye dono ki copy banti hai. Yeh cell ke taqseem se pehle, interphase ke S-phase mein hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: DNA replication is the process in which the molecule of DNA makes its identical copy

blocks.text: 19.3.1 Models Proposed for the Mechanism of DNA Replication

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between the semi-conservative and dispersive models of DNA replication.
(DNA replication ke semi-conservative aur dispersive models mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono models mein parent double helix toot-ta hai, magar mukhtalif tareeqe se.

book_ref.quote: Each of these strands acts as a template for the synthesis of a new strand

rows: Dono parent strands alag hoti hain
Parent DNA toot kar nucleotides mein bikhar jati hai
Har parent strand nayi strand ke liye template banti hai
Purane nucleotides naye nucleotides se mil kar chaar strands banate hain
Har daughter DNA mein aik purani aur aik nayi strand
Dono daughter DNAs ki strands purane aur naye nucleotides ka mixture

blocks.prompt:
27 Why did Meselson and Stahl transfer the ¹⁵N bacteria to a ¹⁴N medium?
(Meselson aur Stahl ne ¹⁵N wale bacteria ko ¹⁴N medium mein kyun muntaqil kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Kayi naslon ke baad ¹⁵N mein bacteria ki DNA aam se zyada ghani thi. ¹⁴N medium mein bacteria nayi DNA ¹⁴N se banate, is liye purani (bhari) aur nayi (halki) strands density se pehchani ja sakti thin.

book_ref.quote: Then, they transferred the new bacteria

blocks.prompt:
28 How were heavy and light DNAs separated in the Meselson-Stahl experiment?
(Meselson-Stahl tajarbe mein bhari aur halki DNA kaise alag ki gayin?)
blocks.explanation: DNA ko cesium chloride ke mehlool mein hal kar ke ultracentrifuge kiya gaya. Is se cesium ki density ka gradient bana (ghana cesium neeche); har DNA wahan thehri jahan us ki density cesium ke barabar thi, is liye ¹⁵N DNA ¹⁴N DNA se zyada neeche gayi.

book_ref.quote: The ultracentrifugation created a gradient of cesium density

blocks.prompt:
29 What is a pulse-chase experiment? Name its two stages.
(Pulse-chase experiment kya hai? Is ke do stages ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh woh tajarba hai jis mein radio-isotope wali DNA ko organism ki aulad mein talash kiya jata hai. Pulse stage: organism ko thori der radio-isotope diya jata hai aur woh use DNA mein shamil karta hai. Chase stage: nishaan wali DNA ko radioactivity naap kar waqt ke saath dekha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: An experiment in which a radio-isotope labelled DNA is traced in the progeny

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between the DNA collected at 0 minutes and at 20 minutes in the Meselson-Stahl experiment.
(Meselson-Stahl tajarbe mein 0 minute aur 20 minute par li gayi DNA mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono samples density aur strands ki banawat mein mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: DNA collected before any replication was heaviest

rows: Kisi replication se pehle li gayi
¹⁴N medium mein pehli replication ke baad li gayi
Sab se bhari: bhari density ki aik tah
Darmiyani density ki aik tah
Dono strands ¹⁵N ki
Hybrid: aik strand ¹⁴N ki aur aik ¹⁵N ki

blocks.prompt:
31 What is a replication origin site? How many are there in prokaryotes and eukaryotes?
(Replication origin site kya hai? Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein kitni hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh DNA par nucleotides ki khaas sequence hai jahan se replication shuru hoti hai. Prokaryotes mein sirf aik hoti hai; eukaryotes mein DNA ki lambai par bohat si.

book_ref.quote: where there is a specific sequence of nucleotides called a replication origin site

blocks.prompt:
32 Why are supercoils produced during replication and how are they prevented?
(Replication mein supercoils kyun bante hain aur unhein kaise roka jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Helicases ke DNA helix kholne se replication fork ke aage supercoils bante hain. Enzyme gyrase (topoisomerase) fork ke aage jur kar supercoiling ko rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to unwinding of the DNA helix, supercoils are produced

blocks.prompt:
33 What is a primer? Why is it needed in DNA replication?
(Primer kya hai? DNA replication mein is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primer 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka chhota tukra hai jo enzyme primase origin par har template strand ke saamne lagata hai. Is ki zaroorat is liye hai ke khuli strands par nayi DNA tab tak nahin banti jab tak template par kuch nucleotides pehle se na lage hon.

book_ref.quote: an enzyme primase attaches some RNA nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
34 Name the raw materials of DNA synthesis. How do they provide energy?
(DNA banne ke kham maal ke naam likhein. Yeh energy kaise dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kham maal deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates hain: dATP, dCTP, dGTP aur dTTP, har aik mein teen phosphate groups. DNA polymerase III jab nucleotide jorta hai to do phosphates tor deta hai; is se banane ke liye energy milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dATP, dCTP, dGTP, dTTP)

blocks.prompt:
35 What are Okazaki fragments? Why is each one given a new primer?
(Okazaki fragments kya hain? Har aik ko naya primer kyun diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Okazaki fragments lagging strand par banne wale DNA ke chhote alag tukre hain, jo fork se door ruk ruk kar barhti hai. DNA mazeed khulne par enzyme ko har naye tukre ke liye peeche naye primer par jana parta hai.

book_ref.quote: It makes short, separate pieces of DNA called Okazaki fragments

blocks.prompt:
36 What are termination site and replicon?
(Termination site aur replicon kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Termination site nucleotides ki woh khaas sequence hai jahan replication khatam hoti hai. Origin site aur termination site ke darmiyan DNA ka hissa replication unit ya replicon hai.

book_ref.quote: The termination of replication occurs at specific sequence of nucleotides called termination site

blocks.prompt:
37 What part of the parent DNA is conserved in each daughter DNA?
(Parent DNA ka kitna hissa har daughter DNA mein mehfooz rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Replication mein asal DNA ki aik strand mehfooz rehti hai aur daughter strand nayi banti hai. Is liye har nayi nasl ki DNA mein asal molecule ka aadha hissa mehfooz rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: half of the original DNA molecule is conserved in each new generation of DNA

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between DNA replication in prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
(Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein DNA replication ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein jagah, enzymes, origin/termination sites aur Okazaki fragments ka farq hai.

book_ref.quote: In prokaryotes, replication occurs in the cytoplasm

Nucleus mein
DNA polymerase I, II aur III kaam karte hain
Kam az kam 14 polymerases (maslan alpha, delta, epsilon)
Aik origin aur aik termination site
Har chromosome par kayi origin aur termination sites; kayi replicons

Okazaki fragments chhote (100-200 nucleotides)

blocks.prompt:
39 How do eukaryotes replicate their massive amount of DNA in time?
(Eukaryotes apni bohat zyada DNA waqt par kaise replicate karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes ke paas bohat zyada seedhi (linear) DNA hoti hai. Is ki kami poori karne ke liye woh aik hi chromosome par hazaron origin sites se aik saath replication shuru karte hain.

book_ref.quote: eukaryotes start replication at thousands of different origin sites

blocks.prompt:
40 Give two uses of DNA replication in biotechnology other than PCR.
(PCR ke ilawa biotechnology mein DNA replication ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Recombinant DNA technology: mukhtalif zariyon se kaati gayi DNA ko replicate kar ke barhaya jata hai.
2. Genome sequencing: genome ki kayi copies bana kar un ki sequence maloom ki jati hai.
(Diagnostic studies bhi: mareez ki DNA ke khaas hisse replicate kar ke mutations dhoondi jati hain.)

book_ref.quote: In genome sequencing, scientists use DNA replication

blocks.prompt:
41 Differentiate between stability and variability of DNA.
(DNA ki stability aur variability mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono replicate hoti DNA ki khasiyat hain.

book_ref.quote: While stability is the rule

rows: DNA ka durusti se copy hona
DNA sequence mein mustaqil tabdeeli (mutation)
Yeh qaida hai; DNA polymerase III ki proofreading se qaim
Yeh istisna hai; replication ki ghalti ya mahol ki wajah se
Organism ke khaas traits barqarar rakhti hai
Naye traits ka bunyadi zariya; evolution ka kham maal

blocks.prompt:
42 What is meant by gene expression?
(Gene expression se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene DNA par nucleotides ki khaas sequence hai jo polypeptide banwati hai. Gene apna izhar protein ya enzyme bana kar karta hai jo kisi khaas trait ki nashonuma ko control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: a gene expresses itself by making a protein or an enzyme

blocks.prompt:
43 Which questions arose about the genetic code after the discovery of DNA structure and central dogma?
(DNA ki banawat aur central dogma ke baad genetic code ke bare mein kaun se sawal paida hue?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Sirf chaar nucleotides wali DNA hazaron proteins ki maloomat kaise rakhti hai?
2. Genetic code ki noiyat kya hai?
3. Nucleotides ki tarteeb polypeptide mein amino acids ki tarteeb kaise tay karti hai?

book_ref.quote: How can DNA, a substance containing only four different nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
44 Why did Crick conclude that a codon must have three nucleotides?
(Crick ne yeh natija kyun nikala ke codon mein teen nucleotides hone chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Akele nucleotides sirf 4 aur jore sirf 16 (4 × 4) amino acids ka code dete, jo 20 se kam hain. Triplets 64 (4 × 4 × 4) combinations dete hain, jo 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi se zyada hain.

book_ref.quote: They reached to a conclusion that one codon should be a sequence of 3 nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
45 Describe Nirenberg's poly-U experiment and its result.
(Nirenberg ka poly-U tajarba aur us ka natija bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 1961 mein Marshall Nirenberg ne poly-U mRNA (sirf uracil nucleotides) banai aur bacteria ke cytoplasm mein dali. Bacteria ne bohat se phenylalanine wali polypeptide banai, is liye natija nikla ke codon UUU phenylalanine ka hai.

book_ref.quote: In 1961, the American biochemist, Marshall Nirenberg made a poly-U mRNA

blocks.prompt:
46 Who shared the 1968 Nobel Prize in Physiology & Medicine and for what work?
(1968 ka Nobel Prize (Physiology & Medicine) kis ko aur kis kaam par mila?)
blocks.explanation: Nirenberg ko genetic code par kaam, Har Gobind Khorana ko nucleic acids ki tayyari aur Robert Holley ko transfer-RNA ki kimiyai banawat daryaft karne par.

book_ref.quote: The 1968 Nobel Prize in Physiology

blocks.prompt:
47 What is meant by universality of the genetic code? Give an exception.
(Genetic code ki universality se kya murad hai? Aik istisna batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Genetic code taqreeban tamam organisms mein aik jaisa hai, maslan AGA bacteria, insanon aur sab mein arginine hai; is liye genes muntaqil ho sakte hain. Istisna: mitochondria ki DNA ka code thora mukhtalif hai (kuch ciliates aur viruses ka bhi).

book_ref.quote: The genetic code is same in almost all organisms

blocks.prompt:
48 What is meant by the genetic code being non-overlapping? Give an example.
(Genetic code ke non-overlapping hone ka kya matlab hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Har triplet codon saath wale codons se alag parha jata hai. Maslan AUGAGCGCA sirf AUG/AGC/GCA parha jata hai, kabhi AUG/UGA/GAG nahin.

book_ref.quote: each triplet codon is read independently of the adjacent codons

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between the template strand and the coding strand of DNA.
(DNA ki template strand aur coding strand mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: DNA ki do strands mein se sirf aik transcribe hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Only one strand of DNA, called the template strand, is transcribed

rows: Transcribe hoti hai
Transcribe nahin hoti
mRNA is ki complementary hai
Is ki sequence mRNA jaisi hai, bas U ki jagah T

Sense (+) strand bhi kehlati hai

blocks.prompt:
50 What is a promoter? Is it transcribed?
(Promoter kya hai? Kya yeh transcribe hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Promoter template DNA par nucleotides ki khaas sequence hai jis se RNA polymerase jur kar transcription shuru karta hai. Yeh khud transcribe nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: This sequence is called promoter

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between the promoters of prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
(Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes ke promoters mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein gene ke start point se pehle muqarrar faslon par do promoters hain.

book_ref.quote: In prokaryotes, a promoter TTGACA is present 35 nucleotides before the start point of gene

rows: TTGACA, start point se 35 nucleotides pehle (–35 sequence)
TATAAA (TATA box), start point se 25 nucleotides pehle (–25 sequence)
TATAAT, start point se 10 nucleotides pehle (–10 sequence)
GGCCAATCT (CAAT box), start point se 70 nucleotides pehle (–70 sequence)

blocks.prompt:
52 Name the RNA polymerases of eukaryotes and the RNA each makes.
(Eukaryotes ke RNA polymerases aur har aik ki banai RNA ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: RNA polymerase I nucleolus mein rRNA banata hai; RNA polymerase II mRNA; RNA polymerase III tRNA. (Prokaryotes mein teenon ke liye sirf aik RNA polymerase hai.)

book_ref.quote: Eukaryotes have three different RNA polymerases

blocks.prompt:
53 What is a transcription bubble? How is it formed?
(Transcription bubble kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Promoter se jurne par RNA polymerase ki σ subunit hat jati hai; baqi chaar subunits (core enzyme) DNA kholti aur base-pairs torti hain. Is se bulbule jaisi structure, transcription bubble, banti hai jis mein RNA chain banti hai.

book_ref.quote: It results in the formation of a bubble-like structure

blocks.prompt:
54 What is a GC hairpin? How does it help to end transcription?
(GC hairpin kya hai? Yeh transcription khatam karne mein kaise madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stop region ke GC pairs transcribe hone par mRNA strand ke andar hydrogen bonds bante hain aur loop banta hai jise GC hairpin kehte hain, jis ke saath chaar ya zyada U ki tail hoti hai. Yeh RNA polymerase ko rokta hai; kamzor U-A jorai hybrid ko thaam nahin sakti, RNA alag hoti hai aur transcription ruk jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This intra-strand nucleotide-pairing (base-pairing) creates a loop

blocks.prompt:
